summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: fix observed missing SQLite usage row while panel readers run; retain capture and never replay inference. Enable WAL and reproduce held-reader write contention.

delivery.outcome: Completed inference usage rows commit while panels retain read snapshots. Enable WAL, preserve privacy and existing history, and never replay inference to repair telemetry.
nonGoals: No model replay, fabricated rows or historical backfill
No change to required checks or foreign worktrees

architecture.decision: Enable SQLite WAL before the existing write transaction; retain existing best-effort error handling, schema, timeout and privacy boundaries.

dataChanges.description: WAL journal mode and standard SQLite sidecars; existing rows and schema remain owned by the same journal component.

architecture.rollback: Approved rollback may restore journal mode only after quiescing active connections; preserve all rows and sidecars until SQLite checkpoints them.

validation.evidence: Held-reader regression before/after and reader in a separate process; zero counts/privacy retained
Exact frozen source, preserved required checks and no metadata backfill
